# Authored compound dropdown fixtures

The populated cases are original PyMuPDF output generated by `artifacts/compound-field-answer-20261110/probe-producers.py`. The two empty cases are explicit authored blank variants: set `/V` to empty and `/I` to an empty array, and replace only `(Red) Tj` with `() Tj` in the original appearance. Border, clipping and all other graphics instructions are byte-identical. This correction is recorded in `corrected-empty-provenance.json`; PyMuPDF's Widget.update had silently selected Red in the first attempted blank fixtures, and those attempts/native failures remain preserved. No user content is included.

All pages are420x300points; widget[100,65,350,135], original inset answer clip[101,66,349,134]. Tests preserve every outside-clip pixel, including border, and original source bytes.
